mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases above 2% annualized and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 3 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases by more than 5% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies face production challenges and reduced output.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases by more than 1% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs increase and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is above 4.5% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals strong consumer demand, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to the positive economic signal.
failure_condition: If RSAFS grows by more than 1% MoM and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points over the previous month, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 200k and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp, but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% over the previous 3 months, it signals strong economic growth and demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth > 2% & HOUST increases > 5% in 3 months
failure_condition: If GDPC1 grows by more than 2% QoQ and HOUST increases by more than 5% in 3 months, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.
